condition: Use only if v29 + SHM transport2 + FFmpeg7 still shows substantial VideoSink lateness. Existing real frame/drop counters remain acceptance criteria.

findings.finding: Existing copy_us starts before ram_acquire, so it includes pool lookup/allocation and I420 copy/deinterleave. It does not isolate DMA-to-RAM copy.
Existing map/copy counters omit gst_video_frame_unmap and gst_sample_unref; buffer return/recycle latency may be outside current accounting.
gst_app_sink_try_pull_sample time is appsink dequeue/wait, not pure OMX/VE execution time. The asynchronous pipeline has separate input, reorder and output queues.
1920-wide I420 satisfies the64-pixel alignment fast path: receive_buffer transfers to frame->buf[0]. No whole-frame copy occurs during this wrapper assembly; other widths use aligned plane copies.

Firefox may create from its own shmem allocator, upload software YUV to a DMABuf, or use CreateAndCopyData depending on runtime path. The Cedar pool is not automatically Firefox ImageBufferWrapper allocation. Caller-side image work is outside the wrapper callback.

Current bounded_batch elapsed spans multiple callbacks and includes caller gaps; DecodePromise resolves only after DoDecode ends. Elapsed alone cannot separate inside-wrapper work from Firefox/core overhead.

phase1_no_broker_restart.scope: New diagnostic-only FFmpeg wrapper/client candidate, load via new RDD exec while retained SHM2 broker/backend5 remain running. No return value, wait, batching, timestamp, ownership or protocol changes.

points.site: Wrap cedar_receive implementation once at entry/exit to cover every return path
derived: batch span minus sum active wall = time outside callback, including FFmpeg core/Firefox work and scheduling
gap since preceding callback return, classified by previous rc

sites: all actual pull calls inside pending-AU/backpressure/replay/EOS branches

phase1_no_broker_restart.return_codes: Distinguish client pull0 (no sample), client push -EAGAIN (input pressure), and FFmpeg receive -EAGAIN (needs new input). Do not combine them into a single waiting statistic.

phase2_only_if_wire_wait_dominates.scope: At a necessary broker restart/coldboot, add timings to private broker/backend candidate. ABI and wire structures unchanged.
broker_points: Immediately after complete request header/body: rx_complete_ns, existing sequence/session/op.
Before/after hardware_lock: lock_wait_us; execute duration includes backend calls.
Immediately before first reply byte and after complete metadata send: tx_begin_ns, send_us.
backend_points: cedar_pull entry/bus check and before/after gst_app_sink_try_pull_sample: appsink_wait_us, timeout_ms, sample/no-sample/EOF.
before/after ram_acquire: pool_us and allocated-vs-reused counter delta.
after successful acquire through final Y/UV copy: dma_wc_to_ram_us.
phase2_only_if_wire_wait_dominates.optional_ready_probe: Only if no-sample/feeding remains dominant: a separate appsink sink BUFFER pad probe records ready time into a fixed bounded table keyed by generation+buffer/PTS, never modifies timestamps or buffers. Matching dequeue gives ready-to-pull residence time. appsrc submission-to-ready includes parser/queues/OMX/reorder and must not be labeled pure VE execution.

bounded_collection.enable: Explicit test-only opt-in, off by default; read setting before sandbox. Preallocate fixed ordinary-RAM storage, no new device/socket/file access in sandbox.
bounded_collection.window: One window per test process: record first8 successful output frames for startup and64 consecutive successful frames after120 warmup outputs; hard cap1024 callback/request records and5seconds of active capture. Count discarded trace records if cap reached; never discard video frames.
bounded_collection.io: No per-row/per-packet fprintf in timed sections. Aggregate into fixed arrays/counters and dump at decoder close/client teardown or explicit end of the test, with a strict total byte cap. Preserve full browser dropped-frame counters; diagnostic overhead is reported, not hidden.
bounded_collection.grouping: Keep ordinary polling, pending-AU20ms waits, replay-limit waits and EOS1000ms drains in separate buckets. Report call count and successful frame count, not averages over mixed outcomes.
bounded_collection.thread_cpu_optional: One CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID entry/exit pair for each sampled receive callback or serve operation can separate on-CPU from total wall time. Wall minus threadCPU includes waiting and scheduling, not uniquely scheduler delay.

correlation_and_accounting.clock: Use explicit CLOCK_MONOTONIC in all diagnostic components and record units; no wall-clock or arbitrary media-PTS offsets.
correlation_and_accounting.keys: Client/broker use existing sequence+session. Backend uses generation+wire PTS+output ordinal; FFmpeg logs both wirePTS and restored outputPTS. Unknown/duplicate PTS require ordered local-event correlation, not a presumed unique timestamp key.
correlation_and_accounting.avoid_double_count: Client RTT already contains broker/backend phases. FFmpeg client_pull_total already contains client lock/wire/copy. Nested durations cannot be added as independent costs; correlated per-frame totals or residuals are required.
correlation_and_accounting.safe_transport_residual: For the same PULL seq: (client_metadata_done - client_request_begin) - (broker_tx_begin - broker_rx_complete). This residual includes client/kernel transport and scheduling. Do not subtract entire broker send duration because it can overlap client receive completion.
correlation_and_accounting.distribution: Report count, median, p95 and max by stage/outcome; do not sum p95 values as if they describe the same frame.

decision_rules: If client SHM copy or FFmpeg assembly/pool dominates, investigate ordinary RAM allocation/copy path;1920 assembly should be ownership-only.
If backend WC copy still consumes8-10ms and serial total approaches/exceeds16.667ms at60fps, there is insufficient service margin. Do not compensate by rewriting PTS or suppressing drops.
If callback active time is low but batch gap is high, investigate Firefox image creation, packet feeding and scheduling before attributing it to hardware decode.
If API pull0/no-sample dominates while complete per-frame service is fast, add ready probe to distinguish input/OMX/reorder readiness from ready-frame polling latency.
If all measured service phases fit budget yet decodedVideoEndTime-clock remains negative, compare actual input/output lead and frame readiness; averageIRQ60/s does not prove timely delivery.
validation_if_implemented: Use delay stubs with known push/pull/copy sleeps to verify timer attribution and status buckets.
All old FFmpeg8311 and independent batch4009 checks must still pass with timing disabled and enabled.
Re-run client malformed metadata, concurrency and fork tests; trace path must not change copying locks or post-fork API behavior.
For performance acceptance rerun with diagnostics disabled, same kernel/codec/file/CPU placement and unchanged Firefox frame/drop counters.
